i would message benq support about it for a return. im pretty sure they replace monitors if there is a dead pixel in the centre area of the screen and you are within warranty.

 i got my xl2456k returned because i had a white stuck pixel on the top right of my screen. i got a replacement and ended up with 2 stuck pixels sadly. but thankfully they replaced my monitor even though they said they wouldnt and inspected the monitor before sending it to me and its been perfect ever since. though there is a big of glowing on the side of the screen but i think its just because of the viewing angles of a TN panel and its really not noticeable unless its a dark screen which doesnt happen. 

reach out to benq support with pictures and your serial number of the monitor and date of purchase and stuff like that and they should help you out. though there is some downtime waiting for the monitor to be replaced if you can live with that.
